question.zh-CN: 怎样把分散的演示与运行经验变成可复用、可追溯的数据资产？
question.en: How are demonstrations and operational experience turned into reusable, traceable data assets?

problem.zh-CN: 获得包含观察和动作的训练轨迹。
problem.en: Capture training trajectories with observations and actions.

research.zh-CN: 低负担示教、纠正学习与延迟补偿。
research.en: Low-burden teaching, corrective learning and delay compensation.

industry.zh-CN: 采集工位、操作培训、复位与质检。
industry.en: Collection stations, operator training, resets and quality checks.

compare.zh-CN: 有效轨迹比例、每条成本与任务覆盖。
compare.en: Usable trajectory fraction, cost per trajectory and task coverage.

name.zh-CN: 人类视频与跨本体重定向

problem.zh-CN: 利用不同身体产生的动作经验。
problem.en: Use action experience generated by different bodies.

research.zh-CN: 动作潜变量、运动对应与形态适配。
research.en: Latent actions, motion correspondence and morphology adaptation.

industry.zh-CN: 标定、动作边界、工具与场景匹配。
industry.en: Calibration, action limits, tools and scene matching.

compare.zh-CN: 重定向误差与迁移后的任务表现。
compare.en: Retargeting error and post-transfer task performance.

problem.zh-CN: 补充困难状态与失败恢复数据。
problem.en: Collect difficult states and recovery data.

research.zh-CN: 主动学习、探索与数据选择。
research.en: Active learning, exploration and data selection.

industry.zh-CN: 风险控制、人工接管与自动复位。
industry.en: Risk control, takeover and automatic resets.

compare.zh-CN: 新增覆盖、介入频率与有效失败样本。
compare.en: Coverage gain, intervention frequency and useful failure samples.

problem.zh-CN: 对齐视觉、触觉、状态、动作和语言。
problem.en: Align vision, touch, state, action and language.

research.zh-CN: 弱监督、时序对齐与语义标注。
research.en: Weak supervision, temporal alignment and semantic annotation.

industry.zh-CN: 时钟、校准、标注流程与一致性抽检。
industry.en: Clocks, calibration, annotation workflows and consistency sampling.

compare.zh-CN: 同步误差、标签一致性与缺失率。
compare.en: Synchronization error, label consistency and missingness.

problem.zh-CN: 避免泄漏、重复和质量漂移。
problem.en: Avoid leakage, duplication and quality drift.

research.zh-CN: 数据价值评估与分布诊断。

industry.zh-CN: 版本追踪、回滚、质量门槛与许可。
industry.en: Version tracking, rollback, quality gates and licensing.

compare.zh-CN: 去重、训练测试隔离与可追溯性。

name.zh-CN: 数据格式、共享与数据闭环
name.en: Formats, sharing and data feedback loops

problem.zh-CN: 让不同团队与机器人复用数据。
problem.en: Enable reuse across teams and robots.

research.zh-CN: 统一表示、跨数据集训练与持续学习。
research.en: Unified representations, cross-dataset training and continual learning.

industry.zh-CN: 格式转换、访问管理与运行数据回流。
industry.en: Format conversion, access management and operational data return.

compare.zh-CN: 模式兼容、来源记录与迭代收益。
compare.en: Schema compatibility, provenance and iteration benefit.
